designation.label: Designated Wilderness (Forest Service)
designation.what_it_is: Congress has designated this area as wilderness and the Forest Service administers it as part of the National Wilderness Preservation System.
designation.hunting_line: Hunting here is governed by California regulations as on other National Forest System land. Wilderness rules restrict how you travel and what equipment you may use, not whether you may hunt.

boundary_caveats: This is a designation boundary, not a survey and not a property line. The Forest Service publishes it with the disclaimer quoted on this card.
The lines are simplified to roughly 10 metres for display. Near an edge, treat this as a guide and not as your position relative to the real boundary.

A wilderness can be administered by more than one agency, and each publishes only its own portion. Agua Tibia is drawn by both the Forest Service and BLM in this app, and BLM's portion is about 3% of the Forest Service's — neither layer alone is the whole wilderness, and this app draws no line of its own to join them.

This app cuts these national layers down to California against CDFW's county boundaries. On a cut area, part of the edge you see is that cut and not the wilderness boundary — the state line on the Nevada and Oregon sides, the coastline on the Pacific side. The wilderness continues past it; this app does not draw the part outside California.
Temporary closures, fire restrictions and forest orders are invisible here. This layer shows a designation, not today's conditions.

california_restriction.note: Neither Forest Service layer publishes a state field, so this app restricts them to California against CDFW's own county boundaries. A part wholly inside California ships exactly as the Forest Service published it; a part wholly outside is dropped; a part that leaves California is cut at the mask and flagged. The mask's edge is California's whole outline — the state line on the Nevada and Oregon sides, the coastline on the Pacific side — so on a flagged part the edge shown is that cut and not the publisher's own boundary.
